chunks.text: 9.1 GENERAL

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.1.1 These Rules are part of the ISSF Technical Rules and apply to all Shotgun events during any ISSF Championship.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.1.2 All athletes, coaches, team leaders and officials must be familiar with the ISSF Rules and must ensure that these Rules are enforced. It is the responsibility of each athlete to comply with the Rules.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.1.3 When a Rule refers to right-handed athletes, the reverse of that Rule refers to left-handed athletes.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.14 Unless a Rule applies specifically to a men’s or a women’s event, it must apply uniformly to both men’s and women’s events.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.1.5 Where figures and tables in these rules contain specific information, the specific information in these figures and tables has the same authority as the numbered rules.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.1.6 National Federations, in national competitions may deviate or change some of these rules according to their requirements and range constraints. Any changes must be informed at Technical Meeting.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.2 SAFETY

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.2.1 Safety is of Paramount importance The safety of athletes, range personnel and spectators require continued and careful attention to gun handling and caution in moving about the range. It is strongly recommended that all personnel operating forward of the firing line should wear high visibility vests or jackets. Self-discipline is necessary on the part of all.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.2.2 Carrying Shotguns To ensure safety, all shotguns, even when empty, must always be handled with maximum care and must be open (penalty - possible DISQUALIFICATION).

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Conventional double-barrelled shotguns must be carried empty with the breech visibly open;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) Shotguns not in use must be open and placed in a gun rack, locked gun case, armoury or other secure place.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) All shotguns must be kept unloaded except on the shooting station and only then after the command or signal “START” has been given or when it is the athletes turn to shoot.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) Cartridges or empty cartridge cases must not be loaded in the shotgun until the athlete is standing on the shooting station, facing the machines with the shotgun pointed towards the target flight area and after the Referee has given permission.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) When shooting is interrupted, the shotgun must be opened and any cartridges or empty cartridge cases must be removed.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: f) No athlete may turn from the shooting station before his shotgun is open and empty.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: g) After the last shot and before leaving the range or placing the shotgun on a rack, armoury etc., the athlete must ascertain that there are no cartridges or empty cartridge cases in the chamber. The handling of closed shotguns is EDITION 2025 (Second Print 07/2026) Effective 1 July 2026 © ISSF 385

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: prohibited when operating personnel are forward of the firing line.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.2.3 Aiming

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Aiming exercises are permitted only on designated shooting stations with the permission of the Referee, or in designated dry firing areas.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) Aiming or shooting at another athlete’s targets or deliberately aiming or shooting at live birds or other animals is prohibited and may lead to disqualification.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) Aiming in any area other than within the designated dry firing areas and direction is prohibited and may lead to disqualification.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.24 Shooting and Test Firing

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Shots may be fired only when it is the athlete's turn and the target has been thrown.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) With the permission of the Referee, test firing of shotguns (a maximum of two (2) shots) is permitted for each athlete on each day of competition immediately prior to the start of their first round of the day.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) Test firing of shotguns is also permitted for each athlete prior to the start of the Finals or any shoot-offs after qualification except any shoot off during Finals.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) Test shots must not be fired into the ground within the shooting areas. An athlete who shoots into the ground must receive an initial Warning (Yellow Card). For a repetition in the same round, one (1) target must be declared “LOST” whether hit or not.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) Test firing of a shotgun after a repair is permitted, but it must be arranged with the Chief Referee.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.25 “STOP” Command

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) When the command or the signal “STOP” is given, shooting must stop immediately and all athletes must unload their shotguns and make them safe;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) No shotgun may then be closed until the command to continue (“START” or “READY”) has been given by the Referee.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) Shooting may only be resumed at the appropriate command (“START”) or signal of the Referee; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) Any athlete who handles a closed shotgun after the “STOP” command has been given, without the permission of the Referee, may be disqualified.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.2.6 Commands

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) All range commands must be given in the English language;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) The Referees or other appropriate range officials are responsible for giving the commands “START,” “STOP” and other necessary commands; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) The Referees must then ascertain that the commands are obeyed and that all shotguns are handled safely.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.2.7 Eye And Ear Protection

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) All athletes and other persons in the vicinity of the firing line must wear ear plugs, ear muffs, or similar adequate ear protection;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) Hearing protection incorporating any type of sound-enhancing or receiving 386 EDITION 2025 (Second Print 07/2026) Effective 1 July 2026 © ISSF

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: devices may not be worn by athletes or coaches on the FOP. Hearing impaired athletes may wear sound-enhancing devices with the approval of the Jury (see also G.T.R. 6.2.5); and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) All athletes, Referees and officials must wear shatterproof shooting glasses or similar eye protection.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) If an athlete is found on his shooting station without hearing protection, the athlete will receive a warning by the referee in charge (yellow card), for the first violation and for the second violation during any round in the competition or PET, a deduction of 1 Target will be imposed (green card) by the referee in charge (The deduction will be applied to the athlete's first hit target in the first qualification round)

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) If an athlete is found on his shooting station without the required shooting glasses, the athlete will receive a warning by the referee in charge (yellow card) for the first violation and for the second violation during any round in the competition or PET, a deduction of 1 Target will be imposed (green card) by the referee in charge. (The deduction will be applied to the athlete's first hit target in the first qualification round)

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: f) If the Chairperson of juries declares that due to bad weather, rain, fog, etc., then the athletes may shoot without the required shooting glasses.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.3 RANGE AND TARGET STANDARDS

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Clay target standards are found in G.T.R. 6.3.6

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) Range standards for Shotgun ranges are found in G.T.R. 6.4.17/18/19.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) No athlete, coach or team official may interfere in any way with the range equipment (traps, microphones, control units, etc.) once set by the Referee or Jury. For a first violation, a Warning (Yellow Card) will be given to the athlete or the coach or the team official; a second violation will result in a one (1) point Deduction (Green Card) from the last hit target in the last completed round of the athlete or from the first round if shooting has not started. Any subsequent occurrence will result in Disqualification (Red Card). The deliberate switching off of the control unit will result in an immediate disqualification. If a coach or team official violates this rule, the warning or penalty must be given to all athletes involved with that coach or team official.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.4 EQUIPMENT AND AMMUNITION

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.4.1 Equipment Restrictions

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Athletes must use only equipment and clothing that comply with the ISSF Rules.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) Any shotgun, device, equipment, accessory or other item that may give an athlete an unfair advantage over others and that is not specifically mentioned in these Rules, or that is contrary to the spirit of these Rules, including accessories or devices used to facilitate the counting of targets, is prohibited.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) The use of cartridges with coloured wads is prohibited (see also (9.4.3.1 (M).

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) For a violation of these Rules, the athlete must receive a Warning (Yellow Card) for the first occurrence. For a repeat violation, the athlete must receive a Deduction (Green Card) of five (5) targets from the last five (5) hit EDITION 2025 (Second Print 07/2026) Effective 1 July 2026 © ISSF 387

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: targets in the last completed round.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.4.1.1 Equipment Control

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Athletes are responsible for ensuring that all items of equipment and clothing used by them in ISSF Competitions comply with the ISSF Rules.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) The Shotgun Jury is responsible for checking the athletes’ equipment to ensure compliance. The Jury must provide an equipment control consultation service that is available to all athletes starting on the first Pre-Event Training Day so that athletes, if they wish, may have their equipment checked prior to the competition.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) To ensure compliance with the ISSF Rules, the Jury will conduct random checks during Competition and any athlete found to be in violation of the rules will be penalized, as per Rules.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) Athletes found to be in violation of the rules for shotguns or Skeet marker tapes may be disqualified.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.4.1.2 Equipment on the Field of Play / Shooting Area Any equipment or accessories on the field of play/shooting area shall be deemed as available for use by the athlete concerned and will be subject to inspection/ check by the Jury. Penalties will be applied.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.4.1.3 Shooting vests All athletes must wear an appropriate shooting vest (sleeveless) or shooting jacket (long sleeves) when they are on the field of play and ready to shoot.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.4.2 Shotguns

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.4.21 Types of Shotguns

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) During all events supervised by the ISSF, all types of smoothbore shotguns, but excluding semi-automatics and pump action shotguns, may be used, provided their calibre does not exceed 12 gauge. Shotguns smaller than 12 gauge may be used.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) Shotguns must not have a camouflage finish.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) Due to safety requirements during ISSF competitions, all shotguns must be safe for use and free from any condition that may compromise their structural integrity or safe operation. The following components are considered structural components: barrels, chamber, receiver, locking system, fore-end, and buttstock. Structural components must not be cracked, deformed, or subject to temporary or improvised repair (including but not limited to tape, glue, pins, wire, or similar materials). Any such condition shall result in the shotgun being deemed unsafe and not permitted for use.Modifications to structural components that alter material thickness, pressure tolerance, or mechanical performance — including non-factory or non-professional drilling, porting, or machining — are prohibited. Modifications that are purely ergonomic and do not affect structural integrity or safe operation are permitted. This includes grip shaping, grip filling, and surface adaptations. The grip is not considered a structural component under this rule.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.4.3.1 Cartridge Specifications Cartridges permitted in the ISSF competitions must meet the following specifications:

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Shot charge must not exceed 24.0g (+0.5g tolerance). To determine if an athlete is using cartridges that comply with this rule, the cartridge inspection procedure must determine that the average weight of the selected cartridges does not exceed the maximum shot charge plus tolerance (24.5g);

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) Pellets must be spherical in shape;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) Pellets must be made of lead, lead alloy or of any other ISSF approved material;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) Pellets must not exceed 2.6mm in diameter;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) Pellets may be plated;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: f) Any ejecta (Wad), except for the shot or powder must be translucent or transparent. The shot must not have any colour added. No other element can be added that could be mistaken as a Hit Target.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: g) Black powder, tracer, incendiary, or other special types of cartridges are prohibited; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: h) No internal changes may be made which will give an extra or special dispersion effect, such as the inverse loading of components, crossing devices, etc.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos

chunks.text: a) The Equipment Control or Shotgun Jury must implement a cartridge inspection procedure that is approved by the ISSF Shotgun Committee. chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos

chunks.text: b) During a competition, a Referee (under the instructions of the Jury) or a Jury member, may take out of the normal cartridge control procedure, an athletes’ cartridge/s for inspection at any time when the athlete is in the shooting area.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) When cartridges are sold to participating teams at an ISSF Competition site, the Equipment Control or Shotgun Jury must test selected samples of these cartridges before the Pre-Event Training (PET) for the first event and post the results of these tests so that this information is available to coaches and athletes.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) If an athlete uses ammunition that is not in accordance with Rule 9.4.3.1 a) (maximum shot charge), he may be Disqualified (Red Card); and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) If an athlete uses ammunition that is not in accordance with Rule 9.4.3.1, he must receive a Warning (Yellow Card) or be penalized according to Rules 8.3.1

chunks.text: 9.5.2.1 Duties Before the Competition Starts Before the competition starts, the Jury must:

chunks.text: b) Ensure that the targets are correctly set according to these Rules; Note; the Jury may make use of an approved radar speed gun system to check the targets randomly if due to bad weather or other reasons.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) Review the competition organization to confirm that it is properly prepared to conduct the competition;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) Establish an equipment control consultation service where athletes may have their guns, clothing and accessories checked; and

chunks.text: e) Cooperate with the RTS office in the verification, preparation and distribution of the start lists, both for the Pre-Event Training, the Qualification stage and the Finals, as well as any possible shoot-offs before and during the Finals.

chunks.text: 9.5.2.2 Duties During the Competition During the competition, the Jury must:

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos

chunks.text: b) Advise and assist the Organizing Committee;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) Ensure the correct application of the Rules;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) Check the athletes’ guns, ammunition and equipment;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: f) Make random checks during Qualification Rounds to ensure compliance with the Preparation Time Limits;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: g) Make random checks during Competition to ensure compliance with the rules concerning guns, ammunition, shooting vests and other clothing;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: h) Deal with protests that are properly submitted;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: i) Enforce the ISSF Eligibility, ISSF Commercial Rights and ISSF Sponsorship/ Advertising Rules;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: j) Approve the official preliminary and final ranking lists that are produced by the RTS office and confirm/verify the athletes eligibility to participate in the shoot-offs and the finals.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: k) Make decisions regarding penalties;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 1) Implement sanctions where appropriate; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: m) Make decisions in any cases that are not provided for in the Rules, or are against the spirit of these rules. EDITION 2025 (Second Print 07/2026) Effective 1 July 2026 © ISSF 391

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.5.3.1 General The Chief Range Officer is appointed by the Organizing Committee. He should have a wide experience in shotgun shooting and a thorough knowledge of shotguns, clay targets, clay target throwing machines, acoustic release systems, scoreboards and range equipment. He should hold a valid/current ISSF Shotgun Referee or Judges’ licence. He must have a good command of the English language in order to communicate efficiently with all other officials

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.5.3.2 The Chief Range Officer is responsible for:

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Fulfilling all technical and logistic issues regarding preparation and proper conduct of a competition; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) Performing all duties listed below in close cooperation with the Technical Delegate, Jury, Organizing Committee, Chief Referee, the RTS Office and other staff members.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.5.3.3 The duties of the Chief Range Officer are:

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) To give instruction and to supervise preparation of the shooting ranges according to technical and safety requirements as described in the ISSF Technical Rules, relevant to the Shotgun events;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) To give instructions and supervise preparation of auxiliary facilities such as shotgun and ammunition storage, technical service, means of communication between the shooting ranges, technical personnel etc.;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) To give direction and supervise the preparation of clay targets for training and competition; and to make sure that all targets are of the same manufacture as mentioned in the general information of the competition

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) To provide special (“Flash”) targets filled with coloured powder for the Finals and any shoot-offs in the Finals;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) To ensure that the traps are adjusted according to the settings of the day;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: f) To ensure that all necessary range systems are functioning properly;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: g) To ensure that all range equipment is on each range and properly placed (large scoreboard, tables, range clocks, seats and umbrellas for Assistant Referees, facilities for the athletes, scorekeepers etc.);

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: h) To assist the Organizing Committee to prepare official and unofficial training programmes and give advice in the preparation of the competition schedule.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: i) To make decisions, with the approval of the Jury, regarding change of competition times and range allocations and interruption of the shooting on the ranges, for safety or other reasons; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: j) Instruct operating staff regarding the traps, release systems etc. with particular regard to safety.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: k) After the Jury have approved the target settings, the CRO is responsible for the security of the Trap Pits and the Skeet houses, to ensure there is no interference with the machine settings.

chunks.text: 9.5.4.1 General The Chief Referee must be appointed by the Organizing Committee in conjunction with the ISSF. He must possess an ISSF Shotgun Referee’s 392 EDITION 2025 (Second Print 07/2026) Effective 1 July 2026 © ISSF

chunks.text: 9.54.2 The duties of the Chief Referee, in general, are:

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos

chunks.text: d) The referee must have a good command of the English language to be able to communicate with athletes and officials

chunks.text: 9.5.5.2 The main functions of the Referee are:

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Before the start of any round to ensure that the ranges are safe;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) To check that the correct squad of athletes is present on the range before the start of a round and ensure that the Assistant Referees are ready in their EDITION 2025 (Second Print 07/2026) Effective 1 July 2026 © ISSF 393

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: allocated positions;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) To ensure that the correct procedure is used to declare an athlete “ABSENT” (See: Rule 9.10.2.6 & 7 for “ABSENT” athlete);

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) To make immediate decisions regarding “HIT TARGETS” (in all doubtful cases or a disagreement made by the athlete, the Referee must consult with the Assistant Referees before making a final decision);

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) To make immediate decisions regarding “LOST TARGETS” (the Referee must give a clear and distinct signal for all targets declared “LOST");

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: f) To make immediate decisions regarding “NO TARGETS AND IRREGULAR TARGETS?” (if possible, the Referee must call “NO TARGET” or give some signal before the athlete fires); Note: Irregular targets require an immediate decision by the Referee.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: g) To issue Warnings (Yellow Card) or automatic Deductions (Green Card) for technical violations where appropriate, as per Rules (See: section 9.15);

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: h) To ensure that the result of each shot is correctly recorded (on the scorecards and the scoreboards);

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: i) At the end of each round, to sign the official scorecard and ensure that the final results of the round are correctly posted and any initial warning/s on technical violations recorded. Initial warnings on technical or rule violations must also be recorded on an incident report which must be handed over to the RTS office.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: j) Any disagreements raised by an athlete regarding his final result recorded on a scorecard, must whenever possible be verified, before the scorecard is handed over to the RTS office.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: k) To ensure that the athletes are not disturbed;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 1) To monitor illegal coaching (non-verbal coaching is allowed according to

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: m) To rule on any protests received from athletes;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: n) To rule on disabled guns;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 0) To rule on malfunctions;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: p) To ensure the correct conduct of the round; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: q) To ensure the application of the safety rules

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: r) Complete an Incident Report and inform the RTS on any matter where any Incident occurred that is not already listed.

chunks.text: 9.555 Warnings Issued by the Referee

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) The Referee must give Warnings for rule violations (Yellow Card) and must note such warnings on the official range scorecard (See: section 9.15); also, he must inform the RTS jury and the chief referee about any yellow cards given to ensure it is recorded in a range incident report; but

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) The Referee may not assess penalties or disqualifications that fall under the responsibility of the Jury.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.5.6 Assistant Referees

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.5.6.1 The Referee must be assisted by two (2) or three (3) Assistant Referees:

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) The Organizing Committee will provide qualified Assistant Referees;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) They must possess a current National Level Referee’s Licence and a current eyesight Certificate.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.5.6.2 The main duties of an Assistant Referee are:

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) To watch each target thrown;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) To carefully observe whether a target is broken before the shot is fired;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) To give, immediately after a shot, a signal to the Referee if he/she observes that in his/her opinion the target(s) is/are “LOST;”

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) If required, to mark the result of the Referee’s decision regarding each shot on the official scorecard;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) If asked, to advise the Referee on any other matters relating to the targets;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: f) To be positioned in such a way that they can observe the whole unobstructed shooting area;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: g) To indicate to the Referee in a Skeet event if the target is not hit within the boundaries; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: h) In a Skeet event at the time of shooting on station 8, the two Assistant Referees under the directions of the Referee, must leave their original positions and be placed in the middle of the layout (in line of station 4 and 8), behind the EDITION 2025 (Second Print 07/2026) Effective 1 July 2026 © ISSF 395

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: Referee, to be able, if necessary, to advise him, whether the target is hit or not within the boundaries.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: i) To advise the Jury in case of a protest.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: j) The Assistant Referees have to use either Red Flags or an Electronic Device that indicates a hit (Green Light) or lost (Red Light) target(s).

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: k) Flags can be used for qualification rounds and shoot offs before the finals, the electronic device must be used during all finals and shoot offs during finals

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 1) When the electronic device is used, it must indicate the doubles by 2 green lamps or 2 red lamps.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.5.6.3 Advising the Referee The Referee must always make the final decision. If any Assistant Referee is in disagreement, it is his duty to advise the Referee by lifting an arm or otherwise attracting his attention. The Referee must then arrive at a final decision.

chunks.text: 9.6.2 Training

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.6.2.1 Pre-Event Training

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Must be provided for each event on the day(s) before the start of the official competition on the same ranges and the same make and colour of targets as those that will be used in the official competition;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) The Jury must check that the targets are set correctly for all Pre-Event trainings;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) All training times must be allocated fairly between those athletes present so that no advantage is given; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) For Skeet, two extra Doubles shall be provided (one reverse Double on Station 3 and one reverse Double on station 5).

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) The PET programme must be revised and approved by the TD before the start.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: 9.6.2.2 Unofficial Training All range availability for unofficial training is the responsibility of the Organizing Committee, and must: EDITION 2025 (Second Print 07/2026) Effective 1 July 2026 © ISSF 397

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: a) Ensure that the unofficial training must not interfere, in any way, with any scheduled competition events;

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: b) Be allocated fairly between those nations present so that no advantage is given; and

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: c) Ensure that all team leaders present are informed of any unofficial training schedules.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: d) The organising committee must use the same make and colour of the targets that will be used during the competition.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: e) The unofficial training programme must be revised and approved by the TD or the Chairperson of juries before the start.

chunks.title: ISSF_Regras_2026_julho PT-BR e Anexos
chunks.edition: ISSF Edition 2025, Second Print 07/2026; effective 1 July 2026
chunks.text: f) The organizing committee with the approval of the ISSF TD may add one extra unofficial training day for the second event in the competition before their PET Day
